ess-beta-metadata.label: Energy Performance of Buildings Certificates rated band C or above
ess-beta-metadata.subtitle: Percentage of domestic properties with an Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) rating of band C or above
ess-beta-metadata.sourceOrg: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
ess-beta-metadata.longDescription: This indicator shows the percentage of domestic properties with an Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) rating of band C or above, in England and Wales, for quarter 4 2008 to quarter 2 2026.
ess-beta-metadata.caveats:
This data is taken from certificates lodged on the Energy Performance of Buildings Registers since 2008.

The EPC register does not hold data for every domestic building in England and Wales. Buildings only require an EPC when, sold, let or constructed. These statistics should, therefore, not be interpreted as a true representation of the whole of the building stock in England and Wales, but viewed as part of a wider package of Government’s provision of information on the energy efficiency of buildings.
